Name: The Skipper
Description:
Established in 1964, The Skipper has evolved into the leading commercial fishing publication in Ireland and the UK, with a monthly publication that is available in both digital and print editions. As part of the Donegal based media company Mara Media, The Skipper is printed as a glossy 48-page monthly magazine and is recognised as the leading marine media forum for coverage of all news and events within the fishing industry.

 

With a monthly audience of approximately 11,500 readers, The Skipper is available on subscription worldwide, with our monthly digital edition available at the touch of a button. It is also distributed throughout the year at a number of industry exhibitions and events, including our own Skipper Expos, meaning our reach is wide and is expanding all the time. Our website has on average 26,500 monthly visitors, as well as our strong social media presence with over 78,000 followers, The Skipper is dedicated to covering fishing related matters for our readership and is distributed and sold throughout Ireland & the UK’s coastal communities. 

 

Reflecting our position as a sector leader, the Skipper Expos have proven exceptionally successful and are the ideal place for anyone involved in the fishing industry to do business, network and keep updated with current trends.

Name: The Blueprint Ireland
Description:
The Blueprint Ireland officially launched in December 2023 with the vision to create a society of people who value collaboration and creativity. Specifically, those who actively seek to create innovative intersections in Ireland. This idea was inspired by complaints from fellow creatives about their own experiences.

To achieve this vision, we:

1. Provide a safe and inspiring space for attendees to express themselves through conversation while offering professional and observational guidance from those in the wider community.

2. Establish a network of individuals who are accessible and actively operating within different sectors in Ireland, who will inform relevant parties of the requirements to succeed within the creative, entrepreneurial and artistic field.

The Blueprint is for:

- Those who already have projects where they may need the input of others
- Beginners who like the advice of those established in their prospective field
- Creatives who want to find like-minded individuals to build community
- Established individuals who are passionate about building the upcoming generation

Name: 5N Networks Ltd
Description:
Every passenger on a 300-seat aircraft wants to stream live TV. Starlink delivers between 250 and 400Mbps, roughly the same as your 5G mobile device. The problem: streaming live TV to every person from one shared phone connection, is not going to work. That's the LEO Paradox — and it's why most airlines still can't offer live TV in the air.

5N Networks solves it.

Our proprietary software layer sits between the satellite link and passengers' devices. Using browser-based mesh distribution, a single incoming stream is shared peer-to-peer across the cabin. The result: all 300 passengers can stream live TV simultaneously — for the bandwidth cost of one.

Proven in the air. Not in a lab.

In December 2023, we ran a live trial with a major Southeast Asian carrier using Panasonic Avionics infrastructure. Available bandwidth: just 5 Mbps. With 5N running a test of a 1Mbps feed, 50 simultaneous users consumed only 1.47 Mbps total — a 97% reduction versus standard delivery of 50Mbps. 

TRL-9 validated: flight-proven, operational, ready to deploy.

Software-only. No hardware. No STC. Deploy in days.

5N integrates with any IFE system — Panasonic, Thales, Burrana, BYOD — via a single URL. No aircraft downtime. No weight penalty. No supplemental type certificate. Airlines and IFC providers go live in days, not months.

With simplified commercial models to suit all customer types, we can enhance existing services or offer easier solutions for new and legacy systems.

Our team brings 120+ years of combined experience across broadcast media, satellite connectivity, and enterprise IT — from O2, Ooredoo, CNN, Telenor, T-Mobile, and Vodafone.

Headquartered in Hong Kong. Distributed across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

Investor enquiries and partnership discussions: niall.deegan@5nnetworks.com
